verdict.rationale: Media routing and selective track subscription are fair questions for a live-streaming service like Amazon IVS, so the axis applies. The pack does not document subscribing to a single track of a live broadcast. The multitrack material describes publishers sending multiple quality versions, which is a publisher-side change rather than subscriber-side track selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
